name: A walking glyph settles into the closing claim
looks: A small glowing stick-figure glyph takes a single step in place on a dark ground above the wordmark; a bold two-line claim lands beneath it with its last word in a bright neon colour, a short tagline and a rounded CTA pill arriving last.
build: The glyph plays one short walk-cycle loop (2-3 frames of pose change) before settling still; the claim's two lines arrive together (`y:10px -> 0`, power2.out, ~300ms), its neon word's colour already baked in rather than animated separately. Tagline and CTA pill fade in in turn beneath it.
sound: A soft footstep tick on the glyph's step, a low swell under the claim landing, a light pop on the CTA pill.
prompt: Close with a small glowing glyph taking one settling step above the wordmark, then land a bold two-line claim beneath it with its final word in a bright neon colour, followed by a short tagline and a CTA pill arriving last.
